document.title: Afghanistan: Message to Taliban on Usama Bin Laden (State 210367)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), Mullah Omar Called Washington in 1998, New Documents Show
document.note: [Secret (NODIS)] Ambassador Milam is asked to tell the Taliban that the U.S. has now provided greater evidence of bin Laden's terrorist activities and that the Taliban will be held responsible for any terrorist action he undertakes. Excised.

persons.name: Usama bin Ladin
persons.role: Terrorist leader hosted by the Taliban; subject of US indictments and demand for his handover

mentions.quote: PUBLIC ADMISSIONS OF CULPABILITY BY USAMA BIN LADEN, AND THE PUBLICLY, AVAILABLE INOICTMENTS OF USAMA BIN LADEN

events.description: State Department cable instructing the Ambassador in Islamabad to orally deliver a message to the Taliban demanding Bin Laden's handover and holding the Taliban responsible for further attacks.

State Department cable 210367 instructs the US Ambassador in Islamabad to orally convey to the Taliban a demand to turn over Usama bin Ladin to a country where he can face justice, and warns the Taliban are held responsible as his hosts.

relationships.detail: The US holds the Taliban responsible as Bin Laden's hosts for his continued planning.
relationships.quote: WE WILL CONTINUE TO HOLD YOU, AS HIS HOSTS, RESPONSIBLE FOR CONTINUED PLANNING AND ANY FURTHER ACT OF TERRORISM

relationships.detail: US demands the Taliban render Bin Laden to a country where he can face justice.
relationships.quote: THAT HE BE TURNED OVER TO A STATE WHERE HE CAN FACE JUSTICE FOR HIS TERRORIST ACTS

relationships.detail: Assistant Secretary for South Asian Affairs.
relationships.quote: CLASSIFIED BY SA A/S KARL F. INDERFURTH

relationships.detail: State Department instructs the Ambassador at Islamabad to orally pass a message to an authoritative Taliban representative.
relationships.quote: AMBASSADOR IS REQUESTED TO PASS THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE (PARA 2) ORALLY TO AN AUTHORITATIVE REPRESENTATIVE OF THE TALIBAN.

relationships.detail: Ambassador is to deliver a US demand to the Taliban that bin Ladin be handed over.
relationships.quote: AMBASSADOR IS REQUESTED TO PASS THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE (PARA 2) ORALLY TO AN AUTHORITATIVE REPRESENTATIVE

relationships.detail: The US holds the Taliban responsible as bin Ladin's hosts for his continued planning of terrorism.
relationships.quote: WE WILL CONTINUE TO HOLD YOU, AS HIS HOSTS, RESPONSIBLE FOR CONTINUED PLANNING AND ANY FURTHER ACT OF TERRORISM

relationships.detail: Bin Ladin is treated as being in Taliban-held Afghanistan, hosted by the Taliban.
relationships.quote: SHARIA COURT TRIAL REFERRED TO IN PUBLIC COMMENTS ON YOUR DEALINGS WITH USAMA BIN LADEN

relationships.detail: Publicly available US court indictments name bin Ladin and others.
relationships.quote: PUBLICLY, AVAILABLE INOICTMENTS OF USAMA BIN LADEN AND OTHERS BY UNITED STATES COURTS

relationships.detail: Cable is signed TALBOTT as the sending official.

relationships.detail: After delivery, the Ambassador may share the message with appropriate GOP officials.
relationships.quote: AMBASSADOR IS AUTHORIZED TO SHARE SUBSTANCE OF MESSAGE WITH APPROPRIATE GOP OFFICIALS

sources_cited: US court indictments of Usama bin Ladin and others
Videotaped statement containing public admissions of culpability by Bin Laden
key_claims: The US held the Taliban responsible as Bin Laden's hosts for any further terrorist acts by him and his organization.
The US rejected a Sharia court trial of Bin Laden and demanded his handover to a country where he could face justice, including the United States.
The US claimed reliable information that Bin Laden and his followers were still plotting attacks on the US despite any restraints imposed by the Taliban.
The message was to be delivered orally to an authoritative Taliban representative via the Islamabad embassy, and then shared with Pakistani officials.
